failures.evidence: Every cell that fails it (claude-opus-5-5 at high and medium, gpt-6.1-sol@medium) removes the quote unescaping in the CONTINUE join of _split and leaves _strg_comment_RE unanchored, so a value of 100 x, a quote pair, a space, and text still loses a quote on the round trip Card.fromstring(str(card)). The check calls the same public API as the request, whose expected behavior is that all card values round trip, and cells of other settings pass it with complete fixes, some by anchoring the regex as the reference patch does. It needs no interface that the request leaves unstated, and the grader ran every check of these cells.

failures.failure: timed-out cell of claude-opus-5-5@medium (campaign 2026-11-26T14-27-47-990Z, repeat 0) at the 25-minute limit

The same setting's three other pooled repeats pass all 63 checks in 434 to 1,364 s, the slowest 136 s inside the limit, so this setting's own run times reach the limit. The records hold only the cell's total duration, so they cannot separate model time from provider or harness time.
